name: @wicked/domain-model-schema
description: Canonical, versioned domain-model / vocabulary / coverage / conformance-rules JSON Schemas — the shared spine for the wicked domain-brain effort (estate GROUNDS · brain EQUIPS · garden STEERS · crew GOVERNS · wicked-testing ASSERTS). brain owns it; estate/garden/crew/wicked-testing import or vendor it. domain-model/vocabulary/coverage are DESCRIPTIVE (facts mined FROM code); conformance-rules is the PRESCRIPTIVE sibling (pattern/policy rules applied TO code) on the same confidence + provenance spine.
author: Mike Parcewski
